area-intro: See what competitors in your market are advertising on Meta. Their ads show what others say, not what works: they never become product facts or test evidence.
area-needs-product: Competitors belong to a saved product. Start this test from a product to add them.
competitors-sign-in-required: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
competitors-previous-request-needs-recon: The previous request may have gone through. Refresh to check before trying again.
competitors-no-result: No result came back. Try again.
mock-only: Until then, everything here runs on recorded examples, charges nothing and is marked simulated.
credential-member-action: Ask the Workspace Owner to add the key in Settings.
credential-missing-market_data: Real resolves and scans need the Workspace's ScrapeCreators key.
credential-missing-generation: Real scans also need the Workspace's OpenAI key for the AI judgments.
turn-waiting: Waiting for another resolve or scan that uses the same key.
list-error: The competitor list could not be loaded.
list-empty: No competitors yet. Add a page link, an Ad Library link or a name above.
add-input-label: Page link, Ad Library link or name
add-input-placeholder: facebook.com/brand, an Ad Library link, or a brand name
add-input-hint: Paste a Facebook page link or an Ad Library link, or type the brand name. Put the official website below.
add-kind-ad_library: Ad Library link: the page is confirmed at once, free.
add-kind-facebook_id: Page link with its ID: the page is confirmed at once, free.
add-kind-facebook_alias: Page link by name only: finding its page ID is a paid resolve. You will see the cost before it starts.
add-kind-website: This looks like a website. It will go into the website field; then type the brand name to search.
add-kind-website-moved: The website is in its field. Now type the brand name to search for.
add-kind-name: Name: finding the right page is a paid resolve. You will see the cost before it starts.
add-website-hint: Landing pages are compared with it to pick the right page.
add-role-hint: Add your own page as a baseline. It is never counted as a competitor.
row-name-after-scan: A link confirms the page without its name; it shows after the first scan.
row-name-no-ads: Scanned, but no ads from this page came back, so it has no name. If the page ID is wrong, change the page.
row-needs-link: Paste the page's Ad Library link to confirm it.
resolve-intro-name: A resolve searches Meta pages by this name, then checks the active ads of the top candidates against the website.
resolve-intro-alias: The link names the page only as “{{alias}}”. A resolve searches by that name to find its page ID, then checks the top candidates' ads against the website.
resolve-quote-error: The cost could not be loaded. Try again.
resolve-cost-note: Charged by ScrapeCreators on the Workspace's key. Checks not needed are released.
resolution-status-uncertain: The outcome of a call is unknown; nothing is resent
resolution-auto-confirmed: Confirmed automatically: the name matched exactly and the ads link to the website.
resolution-reusable-until: You can confirm a page from this search until {{time}} without paying again.
resolution-expired: This search can no longer be used to confirm. Resolve again.
resolution-load-error: The search could not be loaded.
candidate-excluded-deleted: This page has been deleted on Facebook and cannot be confirmed.
candidate-excluded-category: Its category is not a business, so it was ranked last.
confirm-by-link-hint: Paste the page's Ad Library link (with view_all_page_id) or a profile.php?id= link. This is free.
mode-byok: Real data, with the Workspace's keys
mode-byok-hint: Charged to the Workspace's own provider accounts.
mode-mock-hint: Recorded examples, no charge; results are marked simulated.
quote-mock-note: Controlled Mock: fetching and AI judgments both use recorded examples.
quote-note: Both lines are reserved together when the scan starts; whatever it does not use is released.
quote-resume-note: Only the pages and AI steps still missing are reserved again.
scan-needs-confirmed: Confirm at least one competitor's page to scan.
scan-market-hint: One country per scan. Only ads active there are fetched.
scan-market-unmatched: The plan's market “{{market}}” is not a country this page can tell. Choose the country to scan.
scan-pages-hint: The first page has up to 30 ads, each further page 10. Every page costs 1 credit.
scan-keywords-hint: Separate with commas. Used to discover advertisers not on your list, 2 pages each.
scan-tagged-hint: Only this many of the longest-running relevant ads get AI image tags. It caps the AI cost.
scan-tagged-invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 200.
target-empty-page: No ads came back. The page may not be running ads right now, or the page ID may be wrong.
target-empty-library: View in the Meta Ad Library
scan-partial: Some pages were not fetched. The ads already fetched are kept.
scan-load-error: The scan could not be loaded.
resume-intro: Resuming continues this scan where it stopped, with the same scan ID. Top up the provider credits first if they ran out.
resume-intro-uncertain: Resuming first checks the provider's free credit balance to settle the pages above, then fetches them again.
reconcile-intro: The provider's answer for these pages was lost, so it is unknown whether a credit was charged. Nothing was resent.
reconcile-reason-difference: The credit balance moved by {{difference}}, not 0 or 1.
reconcile-reason-cached_baseline: The last balance before this page came from a cached answer.
reconcile-reason-no_baseline: There is no earlier balance to compare with.
reconcile-reason-credential_changed: The key changed since this page was requested.
reconcile-reason-unknown_charge_in_windo: Another call with an unknown charge happened in the same window.
reconcile-reason-balance_unavailable: The credit balance could not be read.
reconcile-owner-only: Only the Owner can mark whether this page was charged.
board-intro: Each card is an ad as the Meta Ad Library showed it. Relevance and tags are AI inference until you change them; none of it says an ad works.
board-self-hint: Shown apart for comparison; never counted towards crowding.
card-media-available: Image cannot be shown right now
card-flipped: Changed. Refreeze the snapshot to use it in the summary.
card-tags-empty: No value of the product's dimensions.
card-tags-no-vocabulary: This scan has no dimension vocabulary to tag against.
card-tags-hint: One value per dimension, from the dimensions frozen with this scan. Confirming the suggestion as it is also counts as your confirmation.
summary-intro: What competitors say, from the current snapshot: who says it and for how long, not what works.
summary-stale: A newer competitor snapshot is available; redraft to use it.
summary-waiting: The summary appears when the scan has finished.
summary-none: No snapshot yet. Refreeze once ads are judged.
summary-pending: Judgments changed since this snapshot. Refreeze to include them.
summary-sources: Relevant by AI inference: {{ai}} · by a rule or a member: {{other}}
summary-clusters-none: No buying claims in this snapshot.
summary-unclustered-hint: Relevant ads no claim holds yet, such as ones flipped to relevant. Recluster to group them.
summary-adjacent-hint: Near the category, kept apart from the claims.
summary-long-running-hint: The advertiser is still paying for them. That alone does not say they work.
summary-self-hint: For comparison; never counted as a competitor.
summary-dimensions-hint: Relevant ads per value: confirmed by a member, or only an AI suggestion.
summary-actions-note: Refreezing uses no AI and costs nothing: the same judgments give the same snapshot. Reclustering asks the AI again and is quoted first.
summary-refreeze-unchanged: Nothing changed; the snapshot stays the same.
summary-recluster-intro: The AI groups the relevant ads again into a new clusters revision; it may differ from the last one.
summary-drafting-label: Use the competitor snapshot when drafting
summary-drafting-on: On: a new draft cites the newest snapshot of the plan's market.
summary-drafting-off: Off: a new draft cites no competitor snapshot. Plans drafted before keep theirs.
review-system-competitor_crowded: Counted from the cited competitor snapshot; which claim clusters this angle shares is AI inference. Advisory only: it never blocks confirmation or changes the angle's priority.
review-system-competitor_gap: From the cited competitor snapshot; which claim clusters this angle shares is AI inference. Advisory only: it never blocks confirmation or changes the angle's priority.
review-system-competitor_copy_reuse: Deterministic check against the cited competitor snapshot. It clears when this copy is rewritten in your own words; your own page's ads are not checked.
discovery-intro: Advertisers your keywords found outside your list, each judged by AI (an inference, not a fact). Accept one to add it as a competitor, or reject it so later scans leave it out.
discovery-load-error: The advertisers found could not be loaded.
discovery-waiting: The scan judges the advertisers its keywords found after everything else.
discovery-not-run: This scan has not judged the advertisers its keywords found. Resume the scan to do it.
discovery-reason-no_candidates: The keywords found no advertiser outside your list.
discovery-reason-calls_failed: Some advertisers could not be judged.
discovery-reason-ordinals_exhausted: More advertisers were found than this run could judge.
discovery-reason-stopped: Judging stopped before every advertiser was done.
discovery-resume-hint: Resume the scan to judge the rest.
discovery-counts_one: {{recommended}} recommended of {{formatted}} advertiser judged; {{unrelated}} judged unrelated are not listed.
discovery-counts: {{recommended}} recommended of {{formatted}} advertisers judged; {{unrelated}} judged unrelated are not listed.
discovery-over-cap_one: {{formatted}} more advertiser was not judged (the scan's limit).
discovery-over-cap: {{formatted}} more advertisers were not judged (the scan's limit).
discovery-none: None of the advertisers found sells in your category.
discovery-state-accepted: Added to your competitors. The next scan fetches its page.
discovery-state-rejected: Rejected. Later scans will not recommend it.
discovery-state-rejected-reason: Rejected ({{reason}}). Later scans will not recommend it.
discovery-state-archived: Accepted before, but it is no longer on your competitor list. Decide again.
discovery-confirm-free: Its page ID comes from these ads, so it is confirmed at once: no resolve, no charge.
